_doc: Vehicles and people drawn by native/src/render/agents (spec world.md §5-§6, Roadcraft carBody.ts / heavyBody.ts / vehicleModels.ts / people looks.ts). Metres; model frame +Z forward, +X the driver's left, Y up. car_body: [fine (the cabin level), coarse] stations, steps round each arch and in each rounded end; the half ring's bottom corner radius bottom_round_m and the flank's bulge (share of the half width), measured on side and front photos of the reference cars at ~130 px/m (a 6-8 px corner, a 2 % wider waist); the B pillar b_pillar_m and the door seams door_seam_m wide (the seams drawn wider than a real 3-5 mm gap so they read at ~10 m, 1 px at 100 px/m); the wing mirror's housing [out, high, long] on its arm, the door handle [long, high, out], measured on the same photos. car_body.bumper_top_m: the ends' dark bumper face up to the top of the bumper zone, 20 in over the road (US 49 CFR Part 581, bumper standard). Car 'top' = roof line points [x share of length from the centre (front +0.5), y share of height], front to back. wheel_jump_m: a pose jump larger than this (respawn) does not turn the wheels. People: the cooked MakeHuman (CC0) bodies with the Rocketbox (MIT) walk in project/assets/people (tools/assets/cook_people.py); lod_m = camera distance where each level ends; tints as Roadcraft looks.ts.

cars_cabin._doc: A car's cabin (agent_cabin over car_body.cpp): rows of two seats from the windscreen base back, as many as fit before the rear screen; seat_spread: a seat's middle from the car's, as a share of the cabin width; metres.

cabin._doc: Any vehicle's cabin behind its see-through glass, near the camera (cabin_radius_m; farther the body has no cabin and opaque glass): the lining lining_inset_m inside the body, the liner liner_drop_m under the roof, the steering wheel's rim steering_rim_m thick. person: who sits, torso, arm, thigh (w, h, hip to knee) and foot (w, h, heel to toes) as [w, h, d], long hair falling behind the head [w, below the head's middle, d], metres. seats: the styles (Roadcraft 4.0 SEATED / CAB / CHAIR extents): the hip point hip_m over the seat's floor, cushion, backrest, the base under the cushion as a share of it, a headrest [w, h, gap over the backrest], a grab handle on top of the backrest [share of the width, thickness] and its colour and, for a driver, the steering wheel from the hip point [forward, up, tilt back from upright in radians, radius, column into the dashboard].

occupants._doc: Who rides and how they look. skin: the tones, drawn with skin_weights (the user's rule: 80 % of the people light-skinned, the first light_skins tones); hair: its colour drawn from the people's hair palette with hair_weights.light_skinned for the light-skinned and .dark_skinned for the others (dark hair with dark skin), its cut with cuts [short, long, shaved]; outfits: a style of clothes each, drawn with its weight, the shirt from its shirts and the trousers from its trousers (at most 8 outfits of up to 8 colours each); helmet: the riders' helmets (Roadcraft 4.0 colours). load, per kind of vehicle, how full its passenger seats run: bands = the share of vehicles in each of equal bands of fullness, from empty to every seat taken (one band per passenger count when there are seats + 1 bands); shuffle: the seats fill in an order of each vehicle's own (else front first). The driver is always there.

moto._doc: Motorbike: body [width, bottom, top], axles at +-axle_z; the rider astride (cabin.person, metres, the left joints; the right mirrored): hip point on the saddle, the middle of the shoulders leaning to the grips, knee, ankle by the engine, hand on the grip; helmet_r its helmet (Roadcraft 4.0 motoRide).

bus._doc: Low-floor city bus (Roadcraft 4.0 buildBusModel), metres, z along it (front +): floor over the road, walls wall_m thick, doors on the kerb side as z spans, screen [base, gap under the cant rail, side pillars], rear_window [base, top, side inset]. interior: colours; driver_m [hip from the front, from the left side], partition_m [behind the driver's hip, width, height], dash_m [depth, height, width from the driver's side]; rows_m [first hip from the front, last from the back, pitch], chair_place_m a seat's room, wall_gap_m off the wall; door_clear_m kept free [behind, ahead of] a doorway; reach_m a seat's footprint [behind, ahead of] its hip (on a wheel housing when within it), sit_room_m what a seated passenger needs [behind, ahead]; housing_pad_m over the wheel arch; back_row_m [hip from the back, gap between seats]; pole_m [thickness, ahead of its row, rail under the liner], a stanchion every pole_rows rows.

truck._doc: Rigid lorry (Roadcraft 4.0 buildTruckModel), metres: the cab over the front axle from cab_bottom, its floor cab_floor, walls wall_m thick, glazed from the belt. interior: colours; the two seats seat_from_back_m ahead of the cab's back and seat_from_side_m in from the sides, dash_m [depth, height, width], console_m the engine cover between the seats [width, height, depth] console_ahead_m ahead of their hip points. deflector_m: the wind deflector on the cab roof up to the box [short of the cab front, under the box top, flat top depth, in from each side] (Roadcraft 4.0 truck).
